name: Algebra 1 Notes Course Profile
role: Course-specific Notes constants. Framework/Assessment Plan own learning; Notes PM owns procedure; template owns shell/order; notes_alg.css owns visuals. Notes author instructional WTC and Example/YTI locally and do not depend on permanent Bank Exit/WTC inventories.

assessment_plan_contract.section_learning_rule: Notes use the exact section Learning Target and exact section I Can statements. Do not replace them with the current Unit mastery-goal I Cans.

bank_relationship.reason: Section Notes teach Intro learning. In the spiral architecture those I Cans may belong to a future mastery goal, so the current Unit Bank is not the instructional authority for Notes.
bank_relationship.teacher_supplied_bank_family_use: architecture_reference_only; author a fresh instructional instance

visual_contract.workspace: compact lined Notes workspace; notes_alg.css must override shared base.css .workspace height and border

standard_section_order: Section Preview: What I noticed / What I wonder
I Can compartments in exact Assessment Plan order

math_notes.hard_rule: Actual mathematics must be visible; styled labels alone do not satisfy Math Notes.
math_notes.representation_contract_source: Algebra 1 Framework §8 — inherit exactly; profile does not redefine it.
math_notes.four_view_enforcement: When four views are shown, use Equation/Rule, Table, Graph, Context/Situation exactly.
math_notes.ordered_pairs_role: Correspondence notation only; never an independent replacement for Graph in a four-view set.
math_notes.required_graph_route: Use the current registered Algebra graph tool directly.

representation_fidelity.hard_rule: When a prompt names a representation, render that representation literally.
representation_fidelity.table: Real semantic HTML table. Ordered-pair prose is not a table.
representation_fidelity.graph: Actual graph stimulus or actual blank coordinate plane.
representation_fidelity.ordered_pairs: Tuple/list notation only when ordered pairs are the intended representation/job.

wtc.source: authored locally during Notes from exact section Learning Target/I Cans + Framework WTC contract + current Question Structure
wtc.layout_rule: Shared setup first, then Parts A-D in reading order. No divider lines or hr elements between parts; spacing and labels provide separation.

build_efficiency.render_strategy: assemble full Unit, render once, fix local defects only
